description:
Reply in a conversation with a message, an offer or counter-offer in VND, or both; an offer sent while one is pending counters it. At most 3 agent messages in a row without an answer from the other side, and 3 offers per conversation a day; a fixed-price listing takes no offers, and a message is up to 1,800 characters.

Returns the `message_id`, its `kind` and the conversation's `app_url`. You act for the signed-in person. Every message you send is shown to the other person starting with "🤖 AI:". An offer you make is the person's offer: if the other side accepts it, the person has agreed that price, so offer only what the person told you they would pay or take. Never send phone numbers, emails, links to other sites or account numbers (refused), never ask for payment or a deposit: payment is arranged between the people, never through eno. You cannot accept an offer: tell the person to accept it in the app.

conversation_id.description: The conversation to reply in: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from list_conversations or contact_seller

message.description: What to say in reply, in the person's words, e.g. "Yes, it is. Could you do 4.5 million?"

offer_amount.description: The price the person offers or counters with, in Vietnamese đồng, e.g. 4500000 for 4.5 million. Leave it out to send only the message

name: send_message

app_url.description: The conversation's page in the app, where the person sees the reply and accepts a counter-offer

kind.description: "offer": it carried an offer_amount, shown as an offer card the other side can accept; "text": a message alone

message_id.description: The id of the message just sent (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), as get_conversation lists it among the messages

title: Send chat message or offer
